name: DigCrew
desc:
⛏️ Start with a rusty old digger and a beat-up tip truck. End up running the biggest mine in the valley.

🐸 NEW: THE SWAMP UPDATE! Four new leases past the ridge.
SWAMP: platinum pay-dirt under the mud. Pump the water out and keep road tyres off it!
OIL: drill the Dry Flats, set pump jacks and truck crude to the Railyard.
SILVER: rip it from the Silver Knoll's hard rock.
NEW MACHINES: 200T and Swamp Long Reach excavators, Mega Haul Rig, mobile crushers and wash plant, dewatering truck, Truck & Dog, paver, roller, ripper claws.

DIG real terrain. Every bucket changes the ground.
HAUL to the Railyard and watch the cash roll in.
PROCESS it: crush ore, wash gold, pour bars, smelt metal.
HIRE DRIVERS and draw their haul routes.

🎮 EASY or SIM controls on phone, PC and controller
🚜 53 detailed machines · 📜 16 leases
⛰️ Dig the Mountain Range with your server or crew up with friends
🏆 Weekly leaderboards, events, contracts and rare finds

Your pit saves exactly how you left it.

llm.loop: dig real terrain with excavators -> load trucks -> haul to railyard for cash -> process ore -> buy bigger machines and new leases -> hire drivers
llm.objectives: run the biggest mine in the valley
llm.progression: machines (8t to 200t), leases, processing chain, drivers
llm.instructions: dig, haul, process, hire drivers, upgrade equipment
llm.thumbnails: excavators carving earth with captions CARVE THE EARTH, LOAD IT UP
